configurations.judgment: RETAIN_CANONICAL_AUTHORITY. Approved list unchanged and the comparison anchor: 33 physical lands, 9 static rocks (42 static sources), 43 artifacts, 25 noncommander creatures, Commander Spellbook 15 included combos with none using Ashnod. Registry recorded digest equals the raw bytes (no provenance exception).

PROVISIONAL_LOCAL_BEST_IN_TESTED_POOL. +Corridor Monitor +Aether Spellbomb +Audacious Reshapers +Priest of Forgotten Gods +Thopter Squadron / -Foundry Inspector -Fellwar Stone -Talisman of Indulgence -Walking Ballista -Esoteric Duplicator. 33 lands + 7 rocks; artifacts 43->41, creatures 25->27. Every add has a sacrifice-cost ability Ashnod copies or completes a Spellbook-listed Ashnod line (1414-1649-2068-4404; 2034-2068-2762-5346; 2068-2762-4659-5346), disclosed. Losses: two rocks, Esoteric Duplicator, Walking Ballista.

REJECT (same-count alternative, staged). Same five adds except Priest of Forgotten Gods replaces Krark-Clan Shaman rather than Walking Ballista. Pass C defended Shaman as the deck's copyable sweeper (sacrifice an artifact: 1 damage to each nonflying creature, doubled by Ashnod); Ballista's abilities never sacrifice, so it is the right cut. MODERATE confidence.

RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE (six-swap, staged, not selected). Preferred five + Sage of Lat-Nam over Jhoira, Weatherlight Captain. Sage draws two per artifact with Ashnod for zero mana, but Jhoira draws on every historic cast without needing the commander. MODERATE confidence.

RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE (six-swap, staged, not selected). Preferred five + Spire of Industry over Exotic Orchard. Any colour with an artifact out, but costs life and has no commander interaction; a marginal sidegrade. LOW_WITH_DISCLOSED_LIMITS.

STAGED_NOT_SELECTED. Both six-swap alternatives together (Sage over Jhoira, Spire over Exotic Orchard). Neither beat its incumbent alone, so stacking them would be padding; five is a floor, not a target.
